topic: specialized multi-agent versus single-agent LLM software engineering: comparative performance, coordination failures, verification, reliability, sustainability, and future work
basis: evidence-ledger.json status field; every one of the 203 reports sought for retrieval carries a terminal status.
note: No report was excluded after full-text assessment: every full text that was retrieved and read was included in the synthesis. The 100 unretrieved reports are counted in the PRISMA retrieval phase, not here, and 24 of them were screened core, so they are reported as explicit evidence gaps in review.md rather than as full-text exclusions. Six reports initially retrieved a PDF whose content belonged to a different paper; those files were discarded at download time once title verification was added, so those records are counted as not retrieved rather than as assessed-and-excluded.
